We are live with Amb Tom Pickering, Tim Landerking and @Dr_Ulrichsen discussing the U.S.-Israel war on Iran, its devastating impacts on the region and the world, and the path forward to peace.

Hosted by @afoukara / @NCUSAR 

WATCH: piped.video/live/GgdH_xFM5Jg…

Great piece by @GiorgioCafiero for the @The_NewArab. 

With quotes from @AmbGordonGray, @TelStratLLC, @AAboudouh, @MarcoCarnelos, @Ali_Wyne and me.

I told @The_NewArab that Iran’s relationship with China is nothing compared to US unconditional support for Israel throughout the genocide and participating hand-in-hand in the war against Iran. 

Yet China’s indirect support for Iran amid the conflict would not only continue but possibly grow as Tehran is trying to intensify and broaden its diplomacy with Beijing.

Great piece by @GiorgioCafiero 
newarab.com/analysis/what-us…

Told @jeremyscahill that Trump entered the war believing Iran would collapse quickly, but instead ran into a country prepared for horizontal escalation across the region and global energy markets.

GCC states warned Washington before the war that any attack on Iran would spill across the region.

Trump admin repeatedly shifted the goalposts during negotiations, moving from no nuclear weapons to zero enrichment, which Iran sees as entirely dismantling its civilian nuclear program.
